purpose: Sample story workspace for new YOW users. This is fictional seed data designed to demonstrate every major product area without using any private user project data.

project.title: The Last Ember
project.tagline: When the sacred fire begins to die, a mapmaker must decide whether saving the kingdom means betraying it.
project.coverImagePrompt: Painted epic fantasy book cover, a young cartographer holding a glowing ember-map before a mountain citadel at dawn, cinematic light, rich teal and gold accents, painterly realism, no text.
project.bannerImagePrompt: Wide panoramic fantasy landscape, river valley leading to an ancient ash-grey citadel beneath distant volcanic mountains, early morning light, painterly realistic style, no text.

characters.name: Rowan Vale
characters.description: Precise, curious, and quietly stubborn. Rowan believes maps should tell the truth even when rulers prefer prettier lies.
characters.goal: Find the source of the dying Ember before the kingdom collapses into civil war.
characters.secret: Rowan's impossible map redraws itself because his bloodline is tied to the first firekeepers.
characters.portraitPrompt: Fantasy portrait of a young cartographer with ink-stained fingers, weathered green cloak, observant grey eyes, warm painterly realism.

characters.name: Princess Elia Marent
characters.description: Measured in public and restless in private, Elia has spent her life learning how much truth a throne can survive.
characters.goal: Prevent a succession crisis while uncovering what her father hid about the Ember.
characters.secret: She has been secretly funding Rowan's map research.
characters.portraitPrompt: Fantasy portrait of a dark-haired princess in practical travelling armor with a silver circlet, composed expression, painterly realism.

characters.name: Lord Cassian Vey
characters.description: Elegant, severe, and impossible to read. Cassian keeps the kingdom functional by making choices nobody will thank him for.
characters.goal: Seal the Ember chamber before the Hollow Court can use it.
characters.secret: He framed himself as a traitor to draw the Hollow Court into the open.
characters.portraitPrompt: Fantasy portrait of a silver-templed nobleman in black court robes, sharp eyes, candlelit intrigue, painterly realism.

characters.name: Sister Maeve Orin
characters.description: A patient scholar with a dangerous memory. Maeve knows exactly which myths are warnings disguised as prayers.
characters.goal: Guide Rowan without revealing the full cost of firekeeper magic too early.
characters.secret: She survived the Black Winter by binding a fragment of the Ember to herself.
characters.portraitPrompt: Elder fantasy priestess archivist with bronze prayer beads and amber-lit eyes, surrounded by old books, painterly realism.

characters.name: Captain Garrick Thorn
characters.description: Disciplined and loyal to the idea of order, Garrick becomes dangerous when he decides mercy is a luxury.
characters.goal: Capture Rowan and return the map to the Crown.
characters.secret: His sister disappeared after joining the Hollow Court.
characters.portraitPrompt: Fantasy guard captain in ash-grey armor, scar across brow, stern face, smoky battlefield backdrop, painterly realism.

characters.name: Nox
characters.description: Nox speaks rarely and remembers too much. His survival proves the official history of the dragons is false.
characters.goal: Return the stolen Ember shard to the graveyard of his kin.
characters.secret: Nox did not survive the dragon war. He was remade from its final flame.
characters.portraitPrompt: Ancient black-and-bronze dragon with cracked ember scales, intelligent eyes, curled in a ruined observatory, painterly fantasy.

characters.name: Tamsin Reed
characters.description: Fast-talking, generous when annoyed, and capable of navigating any waterway that has ever accepted a bribe.
characters.goal: Clear her family's debt to the Merchant Guild.
characters.secret: She once transported Hollow Court relics without knowing what they were.
characters.portraitPrompt: Fantasy river smuggler with cropped auburn hair, teal coat, bright grin, rope and lanterns, painterly realism.

characters.name: Oren Vale
characters.description: Rowan's father vanished after drawing the first impossible map. His old notes are more confession than research.
characters.goal: Keep Rowan away from Glassmere Observatory.
characters.secret: He traded his name to the Circle of Glass to hide Rowan from the Crown.
characters.portraitPrompt: Fantasy portrait of a weary older cartographer with a trimmed beard, ink-stained sleeves, haunted eyes, candlelit study.

characters.name: Sera Thorn
characters.description: Presumed dead by Garrick, Sera has become the Hollow Court's most persuasive recruiter.
characters.goal: Open the Ember chamber and let the old dead speak through flame.
characters.secret: She still sends anonymous warnings to Garrick.
characters.portraitPrompt: Fantasy spy emissary in a bone-white cloak, dark hair, ritual ash marks, elegant and unsettling, painterly realism.

characters.name: Brannic Sol
characters.description: A charming broker who can make treason sound like a sensible payment plan.
characters.goal: Ensure the Merchant Guild controls every evacuation route if the capital falls.
characters.secret: He owns the only complete map of the catacomb wells.
characters.portraitPrompt: Fantasy merchant guildmaster in embroidered river-blue robes, gold rings, calculating smile, painterly realism.

characters.name: Iyra of the Red Pines
characters.description: Direct, watchful, and tired of outsiders calling ancient bargains folklore.
characters.goal: Keep the forest gates closed until Rowan proves the map is not a weapon.
characters.secret: She can hear the old trees repeat conversations from centuries ago.
characters.portraitPrompt: Fantasy forest warden with braided black hair, red pine cloak, bow, moss and gold light, painterly realism.

characters.name: Master Vellum
characters.description: A soft-spoken monk who repairs temple clocks and claims time runs differently near dying flames.
characters.goal: Warn Elia that the Ember is not fading in a straight line.
characters.secret: He built a clock that counts down to the next Burning.
characters.portraitPrompt: Fantasy clockmaker monk with brass spectacles, robe pockets full of gears, warm lamplight, painterly realism.

sampleManuscript.title: The Impossible Map
sampleManuscript.excerpt: Rowan Vale had copied the northern border six times by candlelight, and each time the ink betrayed him. The road to Northwatch should have bent east beyond the toll bridge. Everyone knew that. Every royal map showed it. But on the vellum before him, the road curved west into empty mountain, toward a place the old surveys insisted had burned in the dragon war. When the Ember bell sounded below the citadel, the fresh ink warmed beneath Rowan's hand. A new line appeared where no pen had touched. It pointed straight down, beneath the throne room, into the sealed heart of Eldermere.

sampleManuscript.title: Ash in the Margins
sampleManuscript.excerpt: Sister Maeve did not look surprised when Rowan spread the impossible map across the archive table. That frightened him more than the moving ink. She locked the doors, pinched ash from the prayer bowl, and drew a circle around the road that should not exist. The ash flared gold. 'Your father should have burned this,' she said. 'He tried,' Rowan answered. The silence after that was old enough to have dust on it.

sampleManuscript.title: River Debts
sampleManuscript.excerpt: Tamsin Reed charged extra for fugitives, cursed maps, and passengers who bled on clean deck boards. Rowan had managed two of the three before sunrise. By noon, with Ember Guard horns echoing over Rivergate Locks, she decided she ought to have charged for royal conspiracies as well.

notes.title: Make opening more active
notes.body: Start with Rowan noticing the map change during the Ember bell rather than after a long description of the archive.

notes.title: Cassian too villainous in early chapters
notes.body: Add one small act of protection in Chapter 2 so later reveal feels earned.

notes.title: Use map as product-tour aha moment
notes.body: Make Glassmere marker link to location, Oren profile, living maps lore, and Chapter 4 scene.

notes.title: Medieval lock systems
notes.body: Useful reference for Rivergate and Tamsin's escape route.

notes.title: Nox line
notes.body: A crown is only a circle people agree to fear.

notes.title: Alternative ending
notes.body: Rowan refuses to restore the Ember as a royal object and turns it into many household flames.

notes.title: Chapter 8 title
notes.body: Northwatch Without Bells is good but maybe too subtle. Revisit after drafting Garrick's reveal.

notes.title: Ember sickness symptoms
notes.body: Warm palms, inability to lie near flame, dreams of rooms they have never entered.

notes.title: Possible chapter titles
notes.body: Ash in the Margins, Northwatch Without Bells, The Mapmaker's Lie, A Throne of Smoke.

notes.title: Brannic should be useful, not silly
notes.body: Keep him charming and practical. He should feel like a dangerous adult, not comic relief.

notes.title: Forest bargain needs a cost
notes.body: Iyra should ask Rowan to give the forest a memory from his father, making the bargain personal.

notes.title: Rules for living maps
notes.body: They can reveal hidden truth, but only if the mapmaker accepts a loss of certainty somewhere else.

notes.title: Nox voice guide
notes.body: Short sentences. Ancient but not cryptic. He speaks like someone tired of being quoted incorrectly.

notes.title: Elia's arc
notes.body: She starts by wanting to inherit the system cleanly and ends by choosing a messier legitimacy.

notes.title: Sera motive
notes.body: She does not want chaos. She wants the dead to testify because the living courts keep winning.

notes.title: Important objects
notes.body: Glass astrolabe, ash letters, Rowan's brass compass, Vellum's backward clock, Elia's oath candle.

notes.title: Cover direction
notes.body: Keep the cover painterly and premium. Avoid cartoon, anime, and overly dark crops.

notes.title: AI examples to surface on dashboard
notes.body: Show plot hole finder, chapter summary, and cover prompt as recent saved AI results.

notes.title: Sequel hook
notes.body: If every household has a spark, politics becomes local and magic becomes impossible to centralize.

notes.title: Discarded portal framing
notes.body: Do not use a modern-world framing device. The demo should be instantly readable fantasy.

aiResults.title: Generated side character: Master Vellum
aiResults.input: Create a minor temple character connected to time and the failing Ember.
aiResults.output: Master Vellum, clockmaker monk of Sunspire Temple, repairs clocks that desynchronise near the sacred flame. He notices one clock counting backward toward the next Burning.

aiResults.title: Chapter 1 escape polish
aiResults.input: Make the market escape tenser without making Rowan seem like a trained fighter.
aiResults.output: Rowan survives by knowing the market's layout, ducking through tax alleys and stall gaps he mapped as a child, not by overpowering the guards.

aiResults.title: Expanded Rivergate negotiation
aiResults.input: Expand Tamsin's bargain with Brannic from one paragraph into a full scene beat list.
aiResults.output: Add a private debt marker, a public insult, an interrupted inspection, and Tamsin sacrificing a hidden cargo route to buy Rowan ten minutes.

aiResults.title: Maeve and Rowan archive exchange
aiResults.input: Make Maeve sound warmer but more dangerous.
aiResults.output: Maeve answers Rowan's panic with practical kindness, then reveals she already locked the doors before he arrived.

aiResults.title: Chapter 2 summary
aiResults.input: Summarise Chapter 2 with spoilers for internal planning.
aiResults.output: Rowan brings the impossible map to Maeve. She confirms it is firekeeper magic, warns him that the Crown will treat him as a relic thief, and sends him toward Rivergate with a coded note for Tamsin.

aiResults.title: Act I plot issues
aiResults.output: Issue 1: Cassian has no reason to delay Garrick in Chapter 2 unless he already suspects Sera. Issue 2: Rowan reads old star notation too easily. Issue 3: The market escape needs a clearer reason the gates are not already sealed.

aiResults.title: Generated events from Chapter 1
aiResults.output: Rowan discovers the impossible map; Ember bell rings below the citadel; Garrick orders archive search; Rowan escapes through Kestrel Market.

aiResults.title: Garrick/Sera consistency report
aiResults.input: Check whether Garrick's pursuit fits his missing-sister backstory.
aiResults.output: Garrick's severity is consistent if he suspects Rowan's map may lead to Sera. Add one private hesitation when Hollow Court symbols appear.

aiResults.title: Generated Festival of Embers article
aiResults.input: Create a public festival that can become ominous when the Ember weakens.
aiResults.output: The Festival of Embers begins with every household lighting a candle from temple flame. In bad years, candles gutter blue, which people interpret as a sign of hidden treason.

aiResults.title: Back-cover blurb and taglines
aiResults.input: Write a fantasy back-cover blurb for The Last Ember.
aiResults.output: A royal mapmaker's apprentice finds a road that should not exist and uncovers a kingdom built around a dying flame. To save Eldermere, Rowan must decide whether truth belongs on a map, in a throne room, or in the hands of everyone willing to carry it.
